title: Shipping delays and tracking
content: Estimated delivery dates can change after dispatch. Review the carrier tracking history first. If tracking has no new scan for five calendar days or the package is past the promised date, open a carrier investigation. Do not promise a replacement until the investigation begins.

title: Address changes and partial shipments
content: A delivery address may be changed only before the order is dispatched. Orders packed in multiple cartons can arrive on different days. Confirm every tracking number before treating the remaining cartons as lost.

title: Returns and refund timing
content: Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Provide a prepaid return label when the item is eligible. Refunds go to the original payment method five to ten business days after the warehouse receives the return.

title: Damaged or defective items
content: Ask the customer for photos of visible damage and the packaging. Shattered or unsafe products should not be used. After review, offer a replacement or refund according to stock and the customer's preference.

title: Charges payments and receipts
content: A pending card authorization can appear separately from the final settled charge. Duplicate settled charges and unauthorized payments must be escalated to billing. Receipts and tax invoices can be reissued using the order details.

title: Account access and security
content: Password reset links expire after thirty minutes and are sent to the registered email address. If another person's details appear or an email changed unexpectedly, lock the account and escalate to the security review queue.
